thesis_summary.thesis: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. operates a consumer telehealth platform connecting patients to licensed clinicians for chronic and stigmatized conditions (sexual health, hair loss, hormone health, weight loss, dermatology, mental health, and lab testing). **[Fact]** The company fulfills prescriptions through owned and partner pharmacies, including a licensed 503B compounding outsourcing facility, a peptide manufacturing facility, and a laboratory testing facility. **[Fact]** Since founding, the platform has facilitated over **fifty million** telehealth consultations in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and parts of the European Union. **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$2.35 billion** (up from **$1.48 billion** in FY2024). **[Fact]** FY2025 operating income was **$105.6 million**, net income **$128.4 million**, and net cash from operating activities **$300.0 million**. **[Fact]** At March 31, 2026, cash was **$222.3 million**, convertible senior notes **$974.1 million**, and stockholders equity **$446.2 million**.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** GLP-1 regulatory overhang versus brand scale (compounded weight-loss revenue versus FDA scrutiny and slowing growth).
